test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'TOP' is coded as '22-17-18' and 'BIZ' is coded as '4-11-28'. What is the code for 'MAR' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• 'TOP' is coded as '22-17-18'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b03836362b868cef651af410990bb0e4e0996ec933660355504ddc740e1e135f.png] 

And, 

 
• 'BIZ' is coded as '4-11-28'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d57986e1b8af60933d0f35b352b68b3b2f653f07081d53654a31b21317709d40.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'MAR' is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3742e30bc0234a2b7524049e542f53f744887a262bada1f123f71747f424261c.png] 

Hence, "**15-3-20**" is the correct answer.
